pages.title: Vacuum.IO
pages.creator: Goolandia
pages.description: Vacuum.IO gives a robot vacuum two kinds of work. Gather objects and grow large enough to absorb bigger items while competing in Arena Mode, or clean homes and schools in Mission Mode. Completing a cleaning task unlocks the next room.

pages.title: GIN RUMMY
pages.creator: LEYAN TECHNOLOGY(HONGKONG) CO.LIMTED
pages.description: GIN RUMMY lets you play the card game against a computer opponent. Draw cards and discard unwanted ones to form sets and runs in your hand. Choose when to knock or declare gin as you work toward scoring more points.

pages.title: SUMI
pages.creator: Inc0O
pages.description: SUMI puts you in control of a ball fighting other balls. Move through the field and keep firing at approaching enemies, developing your strength as the battle continues. Survive longer and destroy more opponents to build a higher score.

pages.title: Screwloose Cats: Tail Rescue
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Screwloose Cats: Tail Rescue asks you to free cats from carriers covered with boards and bolts. Move accessible bolts into the tray and place matching colors beside one another to clear them. Remove every layer without filling all the tray slots.

pages.title: Bunnies Sort
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Bunnies Sort challenges you to organize rabbits on racks that each hold three. Drag them between the available spaces until every occupied rack contains a matching trio, planning the transfers so there is still room for the bunnies that remain mixed.

pages.title: My Cat Restaurant
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: My Cat Restaurant puts you in charge of cooking and serving in a restaurant. Take orders, prepare the requested food and deliver it to customers to collect money. Organize the sequence of kitchen tasks to keep the service moving.

pages.title: Paint Pop 3D
pages.creator: Anna Inc
pages.description: Paint Pop 3D asks you to paint every slice of a ring by shooting at it. Tap or hold to apply color, pausing whenever an obstacle crosses the firing path. Hitting an obstacle ends the attempt before the ring is complete.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter: Spinner Pop
pages.creator: Pictofun
pages.description: Bubble Shooter: Spinner Pop builds its bubble board around a rotating core. Shoot matching groups of at least three and look for shots that detach other bubbles for more points. Clear the arrangement while avoiding the Magma Vortex and penalties that add bubbles.

pages.title: Obby & Dead River
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Obby & Dead River follows a warrior traveling along a dangerous river toward a final castle. Fight monsters and pirates, gather loot and improve the character's equipment. Overcome the enemies encountered between the castles before facing the final boss.

pages.title: Hexa Tap Away
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Hexa Tap Away asks you to clear hexagonal tiles that can only move in one direction. Drag out the pieces with open routes, then use the space they leave to free the others. Plan around blockers and narrow corridors as the layouts become harder.

pages.title: Labubu And Me
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Labubu And Me combines styling a Labubu character with creating a matching human look. Customize the monster's fur, eyes, clothing and accessories, then choose makeup and outfits for yourself. Coordinate both appearances to complete the paired fashion design.

pages.title: Zoo Anomaly Simulation
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Zoo Anomaly Simulation puts you in a zoo filled with mutated animals. Explore its grounds from a first-person viewpoint, pick up weapons and fight the creatures causing the crisis. Work through the hostile environment while keeping the approaching animals under fire.

pages.title: Draw Climb Race - The Ultimate Hill Climbing Challenge
pages.creator: 299games
pages.description: Draw Climb Race - The Ultimate Hill Climbing Challenge lets you create a tool by drawing its shape. Use the resulting form to climb steep hills and difficult paths. If the character gets stuck, draw another shape to help it move farther along the course.

pages.title: Love Tile Trio
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Love Tile Trio turns Valentine-themed tile clearing into a timed puzzle. Move a tile into a free space or onto a matching one to create useful combinations. Plan around the remaining room, because running out of moves or space means trying again.

pages.title: Ellie Chinese New Year Celebration
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Ellie Chinese New Year Celebration follows Ellie preparing for a Lunar New Year event. Choose traditional clothing and help with the festive decorations, coordinating the available choices as she gets ready to join the holiday celebration.

pages.title: City Drift Racing
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: City Drift Racing takes car competition onto metropolitan streets. Tackle the tracks in different racing modes and develop your handling through their turns. Upgrade the cars as you work toward stronger results and a higher position in the competition.

pages.title: Deep Fishing
pages.creator: Cat Summer
pages.description: Deep Fishing lets you control bait beneath the surface to find a catch. Hold and move to guide it through the water, gathering different fish species. Improve the fishing gear as you work toward unlocking rarer catches.

pages.title: Striped Fruit - Watermelon Land
pages.creator: Artem Lanin
pages.description: Striped Fruit - Watermelon Land asks you to combine identical fruits into larger ones. Drag and drop matching pieces together, arranging the growing collection so further merges remain possible. Continue building the fruit sequence toward a watermelon.

pages.title: Grandma Recipe Ramen
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Grandma Recipe Ramen takes you through preparing a bowl of ramen with Grandma's instructions. Gather the tools and ingredients, mix the dish and add its decoration. Finish by choosing an outfit from the costumes provided for the cooking activity.

pages.title: Farming Life
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Farming Life starts you with a small farm to develop through crops and animals. Sell the produce at the local market and reinvest the money in seeds, buildings and equipment. Improve production while expanding the work your farm can support.

pages.title: High Speed Crazy Bike
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: High Speed Crazy Bike sends a dirt bike through rough terrain at speed. Steer past the obstacles and keep control over the uneven course, using the available wheelie action as you work through the demanding riding route.

pages.title: Cake Fest
pages.creator: zzgames
pages.description: Cake Fest turns numbered cakes into a stacking puzzle. Put matching values on top of one another to create a cake with a larger number, looking for placements that allow another combination as the arrangement develops.

pages.title: Math Rockets Division
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Math Rockets Division asks you to choose the rocket displaying the answer to a division problem. Read each expression and select the correct result, solving ten questions per level as you work through eight sets of challenges.

pages.title: Sell Tacos
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Sell Tacos puts you in charge of a taco stand with a limited starting balance. Adjust the ingredients and price of your recipe, buy supplies and improve the cart. Use earnings to develop the business and add items that help sales.

pages.title: Real Drone Simulator
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Real Drone Simulator offers several drones and three flying modes. Pilot the aircraft through tasks such as passing checkpoints and scanning parts of buildings, controlling altitude, direction and rotation to position it for each assignment.

pages.title: Aquapark Balls Party
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Aquapark Balls Party sends groups of balls racing along water-park ramps. Choose mathematical gates that change your group's size and guide it toward the finishing pool ahead of rivals. A two-player mode lets a friend race beside you.

pages.title: Mini Tooth
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Mini Tooth gives its small hero a teleport ability for navigating platform stages. Move, jump and teleport past enemies or obstacles, collecting the keys needed to open the gate. Work out how the different movements fit each route through the level.

pages.title: Maze Escape 3D
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Maze Escape 3D challenges you to find an exit from a three-dimensional maze before time expires. Follow the passages, inspect their branches and reconsider dead ends as you search. Different modes provide further maze layouts to escape.

pages.title: Coloring Book
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Coloring Book offers outlined pictures including flowers, mandalas, mountains and peaceful scenes. Choose a page and fill its areas with your preferred shades, trying different combinations until the landscape or pattern has the finished appearance you want.

pages.title: Whack A Mole With Buddies
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Whack A Mole With Buddies puts two players in a race to hit moles appearing on a grid. React quickly to each target, remembering that construction hats require two hits and Viking helmets require three. Try to finish with more points than your opponent.

pages.title: Funky Plane
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Funky Plane gives you sixty seconds to fly an airliner for points. Guide the aircraft through the sky, avoid clouds and collect the useful items along its route. Keep picking clear passages to increase the score before the timer ends.

pages.title: Flip Parkour Pro
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Flip Parkour Pro turns jumps from high platforms into acrobatic challenges. Hold and release to launch into front flips, backflips or other tricks, controlling the attempt through each stage. Work through the different platforms as you practice the jumping sequence.

pages.title: Dotted Girl New Era
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Dotted Girl New Era lets you explore everyday fashion and superhero costume design for the same heroine. Combine dresses, jumpsuits, masks and other pieces into new looks, experimenting with details that can also give her a supervillain appearance.

pages.title: Golfing Island
pages.creator: Mabno
pages.description: Golfing Island challenges you to hit a ball across islands without sending it off the course. Drag to set the shot and account for the obstacles between landings. Collect coins for a three-star result and unlock additional ball skins.

pages.title: Dibbles 4 A Christmas Crisis
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Dibbles 4 A Christmas Crisis asks you to escort a king across Christmas-themed levels. Place command stones so the first Dibble reaching one carries out its task. Use those actions to create a safe route for the king, even when a helper must be sacrificed.

pages.title: Building Rush
pages.creator: Barbarian Games
pages.description: Building Rush puts your factories to work supplying a town under construction. Build plants, produce materials and sell them to meet the level's targets. Earn medals and achievements for upgrade points, then improve productivity or replay a stage for a better result.

pages.title: Block Breaker
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Block Breaker asks you to clear breakable blocks with bouncing white balls. Move the paddle to keep the balls in play and collect items that add balls or widen the paddle. Work around solid blocks as you tackle the level arrangements.

pages.title: Stunt Extreme
pages.creator: Ramblo Digital Media
pages.description: Stunt Extreme combines dirt-bike racing with performing tricks. Change lanes to pass rivals and adjust the bike's balance through each stunt, racing against both competitors and the clock. Aim for first place while showing what the motorcycle can do.

pages.title: Rolling Ball
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Rolling Ball sends a ball past trees and rocks on an endless route. Swipe or steer to avoid hazards and jump when needed, collecting mushrooms for improvements. Shields, magnets and wings offer temporary advantages while you try to extend the run.

pages.title: Shoot And Run
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Shoot And Run sends a gunner along a route occupied by enemies and obstacles. Keep the shots directed toward the threats ahead and guide the character through each encounter, clearing the way as you work through the shooting stages.

pages.title: Boxing Random
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Boxing Random changes the conditions of each round of a two-player boxing match. Deal with features such as long arms, icy ground or rocket-powered punches while aiming at the opponent's head. The first fighter to score five points wins.

pages.title: Home Makeover Hidden Object
pages.creator: Origaming Media
pages.description: Home Makeover Hidden Object follows Emma restoring her grandparents' old house. Search the scenes for listed objects and work through the hidden-object challenges as the renovation progresses, helping turn the worn surroundings into a refreshed home.

pages.title: Alphabet Words
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Alphabet Words asks you to match a word with the image that represents it. Read the displayed word, compare the available pictures and select the corresponding one, continuing through the game's illustrated vocabulary activities.

pages.title: Hoop Star
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Hoop Star puts you in charge of the basket rather than the ball. Move the hoop sideways to catch falling basketballs without missing one. Clean catches that avoid the rim score extra points, with consecutive clean catches increasing the reward.

pages.title: Little Princess Jigsaw
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Little Princess Jigsaw lets you reconstruct pictures of princesses from scattered pieces. Fit the sections together to complete each image, comparing their colors and outlines. A magic button can bring the pieces together to make a difficult arrangement easier.

pages.title: Social Distancing Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Social Distancing Jigsaw uses illustrated distancing scenes as its picture puzzles. Choose an image and move the pieces into place to rebuild it, studying how its sections connect. The untimed format lets you complete the arrangement at your own pace.

pages.title: Zombie Apocalypse Bunker Survival Z
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Zombie Apocalypse Bunker Survival Z brings armed players and computer-controlled enemies into shooting arenas. Move, aim and choose weapons while fighting soldiers or zombies. Modes include survival and team battles, with weapon attachments and camouflage available for customization.

pages.title: Car Stunt Races Mega Ramps
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Car Stunt Races Mega Ramps sends your car onto elevated ramps and demanding stunt tracks. Steer through the course and judge each approach to a jump, keeping the vehicle controlled as you tackle the obstacles and heights of the route.

pages.title: Mysterious Candies
pages.creator: Best Kids Games
pages.description: Mysterious Candies asks you to match a magic plate's color to the candy falling toward it. Click to switch the plate between its available colors, watching each incoming sweet so that the candy and plate agree when it lands.

pages.title: Modern City Taxi Service Simulator
pages.creator: Pixel Studio
pages.description: Modern City Taxi Service Simulator puts you behind the wheel of a taxi in city traffic. Pick up passengers and drive them to their requested destinations, steering and braking through the busy streets to complete each trip safely.

pages.title: Roller Coaster Crazy Drive Game
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Roller Coaster Crazy Drive Game puts you in charge of operating a roller-coaster ride. Start the coaster and guide it through the course's challenges, continuing along a track that passes through water and dark tunnels during the simulation.

pages.title: Bunny Pairs
pages.creator: DoxxaSoft
pages.description: Bunny Pairs asks you to bring same-colored bunnies together while keeping them inside the playing field. Plan their movements around the other animals and boundaries, using pigs when necessary to arrange a pair. Escaping bunnies face wolves beyond the board.

pages.title: Xtreme Monster Truck & Offroad Fun Game
pages.creator: toplight studio
pages.description: Xtreme Monster Truck & Offroad Fun Game puts large trucks into head-to-head races. Drive over the course and use the vehicle's size to challenge rival trucks, working through off-road driving tasks and competitive encounters along the route.

pages.title: Cute Cars For Kids Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Cute Cars For Kids Coloring contains eight car pictures and a palette of twenty-three colors. Fill the selected vehicle with your chosen shades, working quickly to improve the score. You can save the completed picture when the paint scheme is finished.

pages.title: Dart Wheel
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Dart Wheel asks you to hit targets on a spinning wheel without hurting the person attached to it. Time each throw against the wheel's movement and aim for the remaining marks, adjusting as its speed and direction change.

pages.title: Deadly Ball 3D
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Deadly Ball 3D sends a ball along roads filled with turns and obstacles. Tap to switch lanes and keep clear of the hazards ahead. Different ball and road designs change the appearance of the course as you tackle its dodging challenge.

pages.title: CS Online
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: CS Online lets you enter multiplayer shooting rooms across different environments. Move around the area, aim and fire, switching weapons or reloading as needed. Crouching, jumping and running give you further ways to reposition during a fight.

pages.title: Horses Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Horses Slide offers three horse pictures as sliding-tile puzzles. Choose an image and one of three modes, then shift the sections through the available space. Plan a sequence of moves that restores the complete horse scene.

pages.title: Jewel Pets Match
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Jewel Pets Match asks you to swap colorful pets into groups of at least three. Larger matches create explosive power-ups that can break through obstructing blocks. Work through the turn-based boards by choosing combinations that help clear the level's arrangement.

pages.title: My Dolphin Show 2 HTML5
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: My Dolphin Show 2 HTML5 follows a dolphin performing tricks under an instructor's guidance. Swim with the directional controls, jump through hoops, collect fish and splash the audience. Complete the requested stunts to keep the spectators impressed with the show.

pages.title: Zombie Outbreak Arena
pages.creator: Dekman Games
pages.description: Zombie Outbreak Arena puts you in an overhead shooting battle against increasingly numerous zombies. Defeat enemies to gain levels and spend skill points on improvements. Find weapons and power-ups while judging whether other survivors will help or threaten you.

pages.title: Palace Princesses Pregnant BFFs
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Palace Princesses Pregnant BFFs follows Goldie and the Ice Queen through a day at the palace. Complete their virtual food and vitamin activities, then choose an outfit for each princess, coordinating clothing and accessories into two finished royal looks.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Fairyland Ballet
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Fairyland Ballet helps Hazel prepare for a ballet competition. Choose a ballerina costume, apply makeup and arrange her hairstyle, working through the preparations before helping her take part in the performance.

pages.title: Wasteland Warriors Capture The Flag
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Wasteland Warriors Capture The Flag divides players into two teams of four for an arena fight. Shoot opponents and capture the flag for points, using structures as cover. Pick up health packs when needed while trying to improve your team's result.

pages.title: Garden Decoration Flower Decoration
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Garden Decoration Flower Decoration gives you a garden to arrange with flowers and decorative items. Explore the available design choices and combine them into a planting display, shaping the layout and appearance of the outdoor space.

pages.title: Autumn Leaves Match 3
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Autumn Leaves Match 3 fills a matching board with leaf-themed tiles. Arrange three or more identical pieces in a row to score points, keeping an eye on the side gauge so it does not drain far enough to end the round.

pages.title: Tasty Jewel
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Tasty Jewel uses jewel-shaped sweets in turn-based match-three puzzles. Swap pieces to form matching groups and create explosive power-ups from larger combinations. Use those effects to remove blocking pieces as you work through the different boards and modes.

pages.title: Ninja Treasure Match 3
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Ninja Treasure Match 3 asks you to draw lines through matching gems to collect treasure. Connect at least three of the same color to remove them. Chains longer than five award a bonus and add time for finding further combinations.

pages.title: Offroad Snow Jeep Passenger Mountain Uphill Driving
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Offroad Snow Jeep Passenger Mountain Uphill Driving puts a passenger jeep on snowy mountain routes. Guide the vehicle through the terrain and use the brakes to control its speed, working to transport the passengers along the demanding uphill roads.

pages.title: Toucan Shooter
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Toucan Shooter puts you in a first-person bird-shooting challenge. Move through the area, line up the weapon and fire at the targets, looking for the next toucan as you continue through the game's shooting activity.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Flower Girl
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Flower Girl follows Hazel shopping for her role in Aunt Lisa's wedding. Help her choose a suitable dress, shoes and accessories, comparing the available outfits as she gets ready to take part in the ceremony.

pages.title: Hit The Bullseye
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Hit The Bullseye uses a football for a target-aiming challenge. Line up a shot and send the ball toward the bullseye, adjusting the next attempt according to where the previous one landed as you work on hitting the mark.

pages.title: Underwater Cycling
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Underwater Cycling sends a bicycle across submerged platforms. Steer along the route without falling or exhausting the oxygen supply, collecting boosters and prizes needed to complete the stages. Work through twelve levels of underwater riding challenges.

pages.title: FPS Clicker
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: FPS Clicker turns zombie shooting into a sequence of upgrades and perk choices. Fire at approaching zombies, finish waves and earn skill points for improvements. Develop gun statistics and active or passive perks to strengthen the fighter's response to later enemies.

pages.title: Princess Dream Dress
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess Dream Dress lets you create a dress and coordinate its accessories for a character. Choose the available design details and combine the outfit with jewelry, experimenting with different selections to finish the look you want.

pages.title: Fruit Slice 2
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Fruit Slice 2 sends fruit flying into the play area for you to cut with swipes. Sweep through several pieces in quick succession to build combos, keeping up with the launches. Choose among classic, arcade and relaxed modes for different slicing challenges.

pages.title: Epic Roll
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Epic Roll follows a rolling cube over a path filled with traps. Guide its rolling and jumping movement to stay on the route, collecting gold and useful items along the way. Keep the character clear of hazards to extend the run.

pages.title: Hangman Adventure
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Hangman Adventure gives you a category and an empty word or phrase to uncover. Guess letters using the keyboard or on-screen controls, using the revealed positions to work out the answer and continue through further word challenges.

pages.title: Candy Endless Jumping
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Candy Endless Jumping sends its character upward through an endless jumping course. Gather candies and avoid enemies, or land on them for points and a boost. Keep choosing useful landings as you try to climb higher on the next attempt.

pages.title: Ursula Brain Surgery
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Ursula Brain Surgery follows Ursula after an anchor injures her head. Complete the game's virtual surgery activities to address the damage, choosing the indicated items as you help the character through treatment and her return to the sea.

pages.title: Real Estate Business
pages.creator: F2K2.com
pages.description: Real Estate Business asks you to grow an in-game balance through property trading. Watch the changing prices of houses, choose when to buy and sell them, and compare the returns. Mistimed sales can lose money instead of producing a profit.

pages.title: Squarescape
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Squarescape sends a small square through a geometric platforming world. Use taps or the jump keys to clear the blocks and gaps ahead, timing the movement as sections of the route pass by. Keep the square intact to continue farther.

pages.title: Police Cars Memory
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Police Cars Memory hides police-car pictures behind tiles for a matching challenge. Choose a level mode, reveal the images and remember their positions. Find all the matching pairs to clear the board and finish the selected arrangement.

pages.title: 2048 Pucks
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: 2048 Pucks combines aimed shots with numbered-piece merging. Send matching pucks together to form larger values while managing the space on the stage. Keep the total below twelve pucks so the round can continue as you build higher numbers.

pages.title: Swipex
pages.creator: Roman Parada
pages.description: Swipex asks you to place small hexagonal pieces into the larger hexagonal holes. Swipe to move the pieces together and study how each move affects the whole arrangement, working out a sequence that leaves every piece in its destination.

pages.title: Shoot The Box
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Shoot The Box challenges you to destroy a stream of moving blocks. Time each shot to hit the next target without letting one pass, keeping the sequence going while trying to improve the record from your previous attempt.

pages.title: Police Car Parking
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Police Car Parking puts you through a driving test with strict collision rules. Maneuver the police car into position without hitting anything, since a crash restarts the challenge. Complete levels to unlock further cars and try their different handling.

pages.title: Caveman Grru
pages.creator: Enclave Games
pages.description: Caveman Grru follows a hungry caveman on a trip to find breakfast eggs. Run across the changing terrain, jump over gaps and use attacks against monsters in the way. Keep moving through the adventure while pursuing a better score.

pages.title: Bikosaur
pages.creator: SleepingPanda.Games
pages.description: Bikosaur follows a bicycle-riding dinosaur collecting steaks for its family. Ride past obstacles and angry cats, picking up power-ups along the route. Keep the journey going to collect more food and improve the distance or score of your run.

pages.title: Judys New Brace
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Judys New Brace lets you help Judy change the appearance of her braces. Choose a replacement and decorate it with the designs provided, combining details to give her teeth a different finished style from the old brace.

pages.title: Cop Chase
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Cop Chase asks you to outmaneuver police cars pursuing your vehicle at speed. Steer through the chase and look for a clear escape route, earning gems that can be spent on additional cars for later attempts.

pages.title: Maya Brick Breaker
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Maya Brick Breaker challenges you to clear a field of bricks with a bouncing ball. Move the paddle across the bottom to return the ball into the blocks, preventing it from falling while you remove every breakable brick.

pages.title: Gamers Resurrected
pages.creator: Studio Incorrect
pages.description: Gamers Resurrected combines shooting challenges across several selectable missions. Use guns and explosive weapons against the approaching adversaries, aiming to stop the attacks before they reach the people you are protecting. Each mission presents another part of the action challenge.

pages.title: Traffic Car Racing Games
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Traffic Car Racing Games puts you on a road crowded with vehicles. Steer left and right to find openings in the traffic and keep your car moving through the route, judging the next gap before changing position.

pages.title: Survival Race
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Survival Race puts a car in a survival course threatened by explosives and missiles. Turn left and right to steer clear of the incoming hazards and collect diamonds, trying to keep the vehicle intact long enough to improve your score.

pages.title: Flappy Eros
pages.creator: SilenGames
pages.description: Flappy Eros sends Cupid through an airborne Valentine's Day journey. Flap to keep the character moving, collect hearts and pick up equipment that offers protection. Continue past the obstacles as you try to carry the flight farther.

pages.title: MOORHUHN 360
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: MOORHUHN 360 surrounds you with birds to shoot in different directions. Turn the view with a phone or drag the scene on desktop to find targets, then aim at the birds and reload when the weapon needs more ammunition.

pages.title: Angie Summer Wedding
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Angie Summer Wedding helps Angie and her partner get ready for their wedding. Choose a dress for the bride, then put together a suit for the groom. Coordinate the clothing selections to complete the couple's summer ceremony looks.

pages.title: Animal Heroes
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Animal Heroes asks you to match at least three identical animal pieces on a puzzle board. Remove the items required by each level before the move allowance runs out, using useful combinations and power-ups to work toward the remaining goals.

pages.title: Troll Sweeper
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Troll Sweeper hides trolls beneath a grid of land sectors. Reveal safe spaces and use the numbers to locate nearby trolls, marking suspicious sectors before opening them. Limited fireballs can destroy a suspected troll, while uncovering one directly costs a life.
